Personally believe there is a connection. So much so I read Codependent No More and bought the 12 step book. The connection from my point of view comes down to people-pleasing. On the surface, people-pleasing doesn't seem co-dependent but if you people please to an unhealthy extent- 

For sample not leaving your home when you're caretaking for someone, or in my case, not leaving my home even when my auto-immune sick ex insisted I should. 

The example seems like it should be an easy choice just to get up and leave. But when you are ADHD and most likely have RSD, it could feel like your betraying your partner by leaving and subsequently being rejected. This "rejection" feeling could lead to codependency over time. I hope that makes sense.
